messages:
frank: RCA posted: re-ranker scoring drift after config tweak caused rank inversions for a subset of hosted requests. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-4128
frank: TL;DR: a normalization parameter change in the re-ranker rollout amplified feature magnitudes, producing score inversions and noisy top-k for ~4% of queries. Customer-visible impact ~27m during peak.
neha: What was the immediate mitigation taken?
frank: Mitigation: rolled back the re-ranker config, disabled the aggressive normalization flag, and replayed traffic to validate ranking distributions.
yuki: Can we enumerate action items and owners so we can track closure?
frank: Action items:
- R1: Add config schema validation and guardrails for re-ranker parameters (owner: neha)
- R2: Add a top-k stability regression test in the model CI (owner: yuki)
- R3: Create an anomaly detector for sudden top-k churn (owner: carmen)
- R4: Document rollback playbook for model parameter rollouts (owner: frank)
neha: Taking R1. I'll add automated validation in the rollout pipeline. ETA: 2025-05-11.
yuki: Taking R2. Will add a test that checks top-5 overlap against baseline. PR ETA: 48h.
carmen: R3 here. I'll add a Grafana panel and a low-sev alert for >1% top-k churn over 5m.
incident-bot: RCA RC-4128 created by frank. Title: "Re-ranker normalization drift -> rank inversions" https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-4128
frank: Checkpoints: 1-week sync 2025-05-14 09:30 PT, 30-day review 2025-06-11 09:30 PT. Invites to follow.
neha: PR opened for config validation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/pull/653
yuki: Model CI test PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/145 (adds top-k stability test)
carmen: Monitoring PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/451 (top-k churn panel + alert)
ops-bot: Customer outreach template added to RCA. Support to coordinate sends once PRs land.
frank: Please drop any blockers here. We'll reconvene at the 1-week checkpoint to verify tests and dashboards. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
